Round 4, price_now 2, price_next 1 — low prices. Better produce/shuttle than sell. Shuttle gives +3 grey goods. I have 16.8M cash, price low. License auction r4: rent not counted in rank — winning bid wastes cash. Skip.

Best action: shuttle (+3 goods) to sell later when prices rise? Price table descending, price_now 2. Prices low, market will buy anyway? Selling converts goods at price 2 now. Shuttle risk customs confiscation; president is agent 0. I could bribe for influence? Influence helps laws. Simplest: shuttle to build goods for future selling when price higher (price_shift -2... price going down). Prices low, holding goods worthless. Actually produce +2 and sell at price 1 next round? Not great either.

Bribe for influence protects from anti-rich laws. But cash is rank metric. I'll shuttle.
